faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DLSA Mandi Para Legal Volunteer post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the DLSA Mandi Para Legal Volunteer recruitment is 03 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for the Para Legal Volunteer position at DLSA Mandi must be submitted via Email. Candidates are advised to follow the instructions for email application carefully.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for DLSA Mandi Para Legal Volunteer posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Para Legal Volunteer recruitment at DLSA Mandi. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q4. What is the job type for the Para Legal Volunteer position?
faq.answer: The Para Legal Volunteer position at District Legal Services Authority Mandi is a contractual job. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions.

faq.question: Q5. Where is the District Legal Services Authority Mandi located?
faq.answer: District Legal Services Authority Mandi is located in Mandi, Himachal Pradesh, with the pincode 175001. This is the jurisdiction for the recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for the DLSA Mandi Para Legal Volunteer recruitment is DLSA/MND/VLC&SC./2026-2825-2826. This number should be used for all correspondence.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for a Para Legal Volunteer?
faq.answer: The salary for the Para Legal Volunteer post is provided as an honorarium, which will be determined as per the prevailing rules and regulations set by the authority.
